note: Cypress Hills Provincial Park campground at the south end of Ferguson Hill Road, a few minutes' drive from Elkwater, in hilly pine forest. Saskatchewan's side of the interprovincial park has its own Lodgepole campground; this one is booked through Alberta Parks. Hand-pump water is not potable; drinking water, flush toilets and showers are at the Lakeview Shower House in Elkwater, open year-round. --Claude
